<script>
(function() {
  // 1. Resolve numeric value (must be > 0)
  var rawVal = '{{dlv - ecommerce.value}}';
  var numVal = parseFloat(rawVal);

  if (isNaN(numVal) || numVal <= 0) {
    if (window.dataLayer && window.dataLayer.length) {
      for (var i = window.dataLayer.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        var d = window.dataLayer[i];
        if (d && d.ecommerce && d.ecommerce.value !== undefined) {
          var dv = parseFloat(d.ecommerce.value);
          if (!isNaN(dv) && dv > 0) {
            numVal = dv;
            break;
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }

  // 2. Resolve currency (must be exactly 3 uppercase letters, e.g. BDT)
  var rawCurr = '{{dlv - ecommerce.currency}}';
  var curr = (rawCurr && rawCurr !== 'undefined' && rawCurr !== 'null')
    ? String(rawCurr).trim().toUpperCase().replace(/[^A-Z]/g, '')
    : '';

  if (!curr || curr.length !== 3) {
    if (window.dataLayer && window.dataLayer.length) {
      for (var j = window.dataLayer.length - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
        var e = window.dataLayer[j];
        if (e && e.ecommerce && e.ecommerce.currency) {
          var dc = String(e.ecommerce.currency).trim().toUpperCase().replace(/[^A-Z]/g, '');
          if (dc.length === 3) {
            curr = dc;
            break;
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
  if (!curr || curr.length !== 3) curr = 'BDT';

  // Skip invalid purchase events where value is not > 0
  if (isNaN(numVal) || numVal <= 0) {
    return;
  }

  var finalValue = Number(numVal.toFixed(2));

  // 3. User Data / Advanced Matching
  var userData = {};
  var email = '{{dlv - user_data.email}}';
  var phone = '{{dlv - user_data.phone_number}}';
  var externalId = '{{dlv - user_data.external_id}}';

  if (email && email !== 'undefined' && email !== 'null') {
    userData.em = email.toLowerCase().trim();
  }
  if (phone && phone !== 'undefined' && phone !== 'null') {
    userData.ph = phone.trim();
  }
  if (externalId && externalId !== 'undefined' && externalId !== 'null') {
    userData.external_id = externalId.trim();
  }
  // fbc is not an Advanced Matching key: the Pixel reads the _fbc cookie
  // itself. The server-side copy of this Purchase gets it from the GA4
  // purchase tag's `fbc` parameter instead.

  if (Object.keys(userData).length > 0) {
    fbq('init', '{{Const - Meta Pixel ID}}', userData);
  }

  // 4. Transaction / Deduplication ID
  var orderId = '{{dlv - ecommerce.transaction_id}}';
  if (!orderId || orderId === 'undefined' || orderId === 'null') {
    if (window.dataLayer && window.dataLayer.length) {
      for (var k = window.dataLayer.length - 1; k >= 0; k--) {
        var t = window.dataLayer[k];
        if (t && t.ecommerce && t.ecommerce.transaction_id) {
          orderId = String(t.ecommerce.transaction_id);
          break;
        }
      }
    }
  }


  // Catalog matching. Parsed rather than interpolated: GTM turns an array
  // into "a,b,c" when it substitutes into HTML, so the variables hand over
  // JSON and this turns it back into a real array.
  var contentIds = [];
  var contents = [];
  try { contentIds = JSON.parse('{{CJS - Meta content_ids}}') || []; } catch (e) {}
  try { contents = JSON.parse('{{CJS - Meta contents}}') || []; } catch (e) {}

  var purchaseParams = {
    content_type: 'product',
    value: finalValue,
    currency: curr
  };
  if (contentIds.length) { purchaseParams.content_ids = contentIds; }
  if (contents.length) { purchaseParams.contents = contents; }
  if (contents.length) {
    var numItems = 0;
    for (var n = 0; n < contents.length; n++) { numItems += contents[n].quantity || 0; }
    if (numItems > 0) { purchaseParams.num_items = numItems; }
  }
  if (orderId && orderId !== 'undefined' && orderId !== 'null') {
    purchaseParams.order_id = orderId;
  }

  // The server container's CAPI tag reads event_id off the same dataLayer
  // push, so both sides send the same value and Meta collapses the pair.
  // The derivation below is the old behaviour, kept only for a browser still
  // running JS cached from before the app started sending event_id.
  var eventOptions = {};
  var _eid = '{{dlv - event_id}}';
  if (_eid && _eid !== 'undefined' && _eid !== 'null') {
    eventOptions.eventID = _eid;
  } else if (orderId && orderId !== 'undefined' && orderId !== 'null') {
    eventOptions.eventID = (orderId.indexOf('purchase_') === 0) ? orderId : ('purchase_' + orderId);
  }

  fbq('track', 'Purchase', purchaseParams, eventOptions);
})();
</script>

<script>
(function() {
  // Split out of the base code so a single-page navigation can report a page
  // view without re-running fbq('init'). The id comes from the same variable
  // the GA4 page_view carries to the server container, and it is renewed per
  // navigation, so each one is its own event rather than a duplicate of the
  // first.
  var eventOptions = {};
  var _eid = '{{CJS - PageView Event ID}}';
  if (_eid && _eid !== 'undefined' && _eid !== 'null') {
    eventOptions.eventID = _eid;
  }
  fbq('track', 'PageView', {}, eventOptions);
})();
</script>
